en.headline: SAR women's foil team claims silver at Asian Para Games
en.dek: Hong Kong’s squad finished second after a 12-30 loss to the national team in Nagoya on Tuesday under the new 30-point format.
body: Hong Kong, China’s women’s foil team secured a silver medal at the Asian Para Games in Nagoya on Tuesday, falling 12-30 to the national team.

The squad of Chung Yuen-ping, Lam Ka-man, Tong Nga-ting and Yu Chui-yee trailed throughout the match. They attempted to recover after the opening relays but could not close the gap against the stronger opposition.

Organisers adopted a new 30-point format with six relays this year, instead of the previous 45-point structure. Team member Lam Ka-man said the squad would refine tactics and use the experience to prepare for the 2028 Los Angeles Olympic qualifiers.

zh.headline: 香港女子花劍隊亞殘運會奪銀
zh.dek: 港隊周二在名古屋以12比30不敵國家隊，在新賽制下取得銀牌。
body: 中國香港女子花劍隊周二在名古屋亞殘運會取得銀牌，以12比30敗給國家隊。
隊員包括鍾婉萍、林嘉敏、唐雅婷及余翠怡。港隊整場處於下風，嘗試在開局失利後追回分數，但未能縮小差距。
今屆改用30分制，共六輪接力，取代以往45分九輪制。隊員林嘉敏表示，隊伍會調整戰術，並以今次經驗準備2028年洛杉磯奧運資格賽。
